description: The AI judge's session on the live site (2026-11-26, 33 messages, scored 6/10), as conversations (Phase 6, docs/plans/phase-6-judge-findings.md). The user judge-user-1 has the five orders a one-click demo shopper gets. Expectations describe what the plan promises, checked on behaviour, not wording; the checks every set gets (promises nothing keeps, duplicate cards, chips that match no card, orders the page hides) apply too. Recorded on today's code first, to show the failures. Run with: python eval/run_baseline.py --conversations eval/judge_conversations.json --cassette eval/cassettes/judge_openai-gpt-oss-20b.json --label <name> --model openai/gpt-oss-20b --mode replay
